_doc: DESIGN→CODE CENSUS capture provenance — how the committed <kit>.rest-nodes.json fixture was taken. REST GET only (read-only): GET /v1/files/:key/nodes?ids=…&plugin_data=shared. The variables endpoint refused with HTTP 403 (the token lacks the file_variables:read scope — a token scope, not a plan limit); the refusal is replayed to the mapper on every census run so the dump carries the same named receipts the live CLI prints.

variablesRefusal.note: file_variables:read missing on the capture token; every bound fact degrades to its resolved literal (named per row in _degradations)
